healthcareRecruitment.title: Healthcare Sector Recruitment
healthcareRecruitment.description: Recruiting international specialists offers tremendous opportunities to address Germany's skills shortage. With our targeted and structured approach, we effectively structure your recruitment process to successfully attract qualified healthcare professionals from abroad. We create attractive job postings that appeal to international professionals with clear job descriptions, salary transparency, and comprehensive support services.

livingInGermany.title: Living in Germany
livingInGermany.description: Germany is known for its strong economy, culture, and high quality of life. We provide a comprehensive guide to life in Germany from the first steps in daily life to successful integration into society. We offer detailed information on finding accommodation, German culture and traditions, language learning, healthcare system, and daily life. We guide you on everything from important values like punctuality and order to traditional celebrations like Christmas and Oktoberfest.

experiencedProfessionalsVisa.title: Visa for Experienced Professionals
experiencedProfessionalsVisa.description: The visa for experienced professionals is aimed at skilled workers with at least two years of qualified professional experience in their field. With this visa, you can work in high-demand professions in Germany. You can apply if you meet requirements such as qualified professional experience, minimum wage conditions, job offer, and language skills. We support your application process with a minimum annual salary of €40,770 and B1 level German language proficiency.

vocationalTrainingVisa.title: Vocational Training Visa
vocationalTrainingVisa.description: The vocational training completion visa is aimed at individuals who want to complete a dual vocational training program in a recognized vocational training profession in Germany. This program combines theoretical knowledge taught in vocational school with practical training in a company, offering young people the opportunity to complete qualified training in German apprenticeships and subsequently gain long-term prospects in the German labor market.

qualificationRecognitionVisa.title: Qualification Recognition Visa
qualificationRecognitionVisa.description: The visa for recognition of foreign professional qualifications is aimed at skilled workers who want their professional qualifications acquired abroad to be recognized in Germany. We provide long-term employment opportunities in Germany by bringing your qualifications to German standards. With this visa that allows you to live in Germany during the recognition process and take professional adaptation measures, we support you in meeting the requirements of B1 level German and minimum monthly financial security of €947.
